title: TwinPing
description: Twin Ping is a mod to sync your ping with other players, especially made for tierlist fights!
body:
Here's a tutorial Twin Ping, made by Hearts & Keztra.

/twinping (IGN) - To directly sync your ping with theirs.
/twinping (IGN) (Number) (Higher/Lower) - To sync your ping at a certain radius below or above the players ping.

Sometimes the mod can take a few seconds to sync to a players ping, so be wary.

In-Depth Description:

Our mod is used to directly sync your ping with another player, which can be used at specific radiuses. This can be used as an alternative to Ravenclaws Ping Equaliser, as it can help you stay at the same ping of someone who may be fluctuating. Our mod is especially helpful for Tierlist Fights, as it directly twins your ping with the other player, instead of having to change it manually when they lag.
